intro: My research interests are broadly in combinatorics and graph theory, particularly spectral and extremal graph theory. I also work on Fourier analysis and its connections to combinatorics and data science.
biography: At Rochester, I work with Alex Iosevich. I received my PhD in Mathematics from the University of Delaware in 2025 under the guidance of Sebastian Cioabă, and an MS in Data Science in 2023.
research_intro: What can the spectrum of a graph tell us about its structure? What changes when we regard the edge set as a function and study its Fourier transform?
